title: Customer page shows Bill Invoices To with the payer's name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B in Edit Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The left card shows a "Bill Invoices To" line with customer B's name.
  • "Change" shows beside customer B's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R1: “When a default other than the customer itself is saved, the customer page left card shows "Bill Invoices To" with the payer's name.”
  • S1-R2: “Users who may set the default see "Change" beside the name; it opens the "Bill Invoices To" window.”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “A customer can have a saved default Bill To. New work orders and part sales for that customer start billed to it.”
  • Terminology: “Saved default Bill To → a customer-level setting ("Bill Invoices To") that sets the Bill To of new work orders and part sales for that customer. Never changes existing ones.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "Bill Invoices To line" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build), "Pays for counter" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build), "Change" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

  • “Under IBS: "Bill Invoices To", "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair", and "Change".”
  • “"Pays for" 1 sits beside Contacts and Assets. Hidden when the count is 0.”
  • “Window "Bill Invoices To": "New work orders and part sales for Buda Truck Repair will be billed to this customer. Existing ones don't change."”
